title: Credits
intro: The Flex Draw source code is public, and the project stands on the shoulders of many free projects. Thank you to everyone who built them!
thanks: The colour palette follows the Tailwind colours. All libraries run locally in your browser; no data is sent to third parties.

libs.vue: The framework for the user interface.
libs.paper: Does the shape maths: combining shapes (unite, intersect, subtract, exclude) and smoothing freehand lines.
libs.hljs: Colours the SVG source code (core and XML only).
libs.tailwind: Utility classes for layout and the design colours.
libs.jetbrains: The font for source code and hex codes, served locally.
libs.playwright: Tests the app in a real browser.
libs.typescript: Finds mistakes before the app runs.
libs.eslint: Checks the code for style and mistakes.
